purpose: Provide an executable two-interval trajectory that proves candidate-only scalar burn, atomic rigid/mass commit and next-boundary committed-mass consumption.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted the recommended fixture-local two-interval composition. Product and Legacy runtime APIs are absent from the executable path.

expected_facts.claim: Each interval integrates with its opening committed mass while the scalar-burn result remains candidate-only until the closing tick.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Tick, visibility and identity relationships are exact; mass formulas use the declared numeric tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The tick-1 rigid and mass candidates commit together, the second interval reads both committed values, and independent Decimal analytic and C++17 RK4 trajectories agree through tick 2.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Commit and terminal identities are exact; position and velocity use the declared absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Invalid identities, interval ordering, mass/flow inputs and analytic-domain values fail directly; early visibility, stale next mass and stale rigid state each diverge from the accepted trajectory.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Domain rejection identities are exact and every mutation must have a positive physical difference.

acceptance: The bundle executes two contiguous FrozenIntervals with candidate-only mass and atomic rigid/mass commits
The Decimal piecewise-analytic reference and C++17 RK4 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Query recomputation, fuel geometry, depletion events, canonical assets and product contracts remain outside this slice
